name: feature
description: Implements a new capability from intent to review.

stages.purpose: Capture what the operator actually wants.
Record the chosen approach, the alternatives it beat, and what would reopen it.
Pin the interfaces, boundaries, and success criteria.
Break the work into independently provable slices.
Write the proof before the code.

rules: Do not begin a stage until the previous stage's artifact is complete and its evidence block is filled.
Emit a decision when more than one approach is viable; omit the artifact when only one approach survives.
If a stage reveals the intent was wrong, return to the intent stage before continuing.
completion: Done when the review artifact is empty of unresolved high-severity findings, or when no review stage was run and every prior artifact is complete.
